test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A study of the conditions and structure of the earth
solution:
The correct answer is: **Geology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Geology"** means the scientific study of the origin, history, and structure of the Earth. (पृथ्वी की उत्पत्ति, इतिहास और संरचना का वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन)

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to major in** geology** because she was fascinated by the Earth's layers and formations.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Geology**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Geography **(भूगोल): The study of the Earth's physical features and the distribution of life on the planet.

 
 
• **Example:** Geography lessons often involve studying maps and learning about different countries and cultures.
 
 
 
• **Meteorology **(मौसम विज्ञान): The science that deals with the phenomena of the atmosphere, especially weather and weather conditions.
 
 
• **Example:** Meteorology is essential for predicting weather patterns and preparing for natural disasters.
 
 
 
• **Biology** (जीवविज्ञान): The scientific study of life and living organisms.
 
 
• **Example:** In biology class, we dissected a frog to learn about its internal organs.
 
 

47:Tbac,
The correct answer is '**atmosphere**'.
